title: VIXEN UI target tests need a canonical staged-asset working directory
body: The queued focused UI binaries failed with exit 139 when launched from the worktree root because CMake stages assets/ui next to the test executable and RmlUi resolves relative paths from the process CWD. Running the same binaries from .tmp/build/libraries/RenderGraph/tests passed. Provide a target wrapper or test registration that selects the executable directory automatically, so a lane cannot mistake a working-directory asset lookup failure for a product red.

title: Box queue should expose a scoped recovery for reused diagnostics
body: After the post-merge build failed on a resolved generated-header conflict, the identical queued command was refused as DIAGNOSTIC_REUSED exit 77. Recovery required manually setting UT_QUEUE_BREAKER=0 and changing the label before the same command could establish the repaired baseline. Provide a documented scoped retry/reset keyed to the repaired checkout and diagnostic, without requiring an agent to bypass the breaker globally.

title: Provision a read-only CodeGraph query route for isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The mandated CodeGraph-first query reported that this isolated worktree had no .codegraph index and the tool directed the agent to continue manually. Source tracing therefore fell back to rg and file reads. Provide a shared or owner-managed read-only index/query route at worktree creation so lanes can satisfy CodeGraph-first discovery without initializing an index themselves.
